scope: Bounded solo Studio physics probes using existing Verification actions; no source/gameplay/lifecycle edits. Initial from/checkpoint is setup only. No test reposition occurs inside sequences.
usage: Submit commands[name] as the bridge Job with a fresh JobId. Require outer ok=true. Read result.passed plus each case manualChecks; the negative skip intentionally expects passed=false, and the pulse probe requires manual classification. Use the current official-racer setup before each independent initial-position probe. Only catch_skip_recovery_continue intentionally omits setup and follows the previous miss.
safeCycleMethod: Two fullCycle pulse/pod waits: the first synchronizes to Clear; the second spans a complete period back to Clear. Leaf perch checks synchronize near local 0, wait to late Open, then next local 0, covering a full nine-second period. Compare grounded support and no-hit/recovery diagnostics, not just the outer command ok.
driverLimits: Pulse jump timing cannot be expressed by current JSON actions; jump=true is only the gap/step scanner.
Late-leaf departure phase does not prove entry phase: require actual firstLeafContact == Warning, or label the real observed phase.
Bloom edge proof requires entry.reason == arrived at entryPoint before release; a premature release is a different takeoff.
Petal counters do not capture begin messages/rendered cues; a native-rim support is not a visible-petal support pass.
All results are solo server-driven Studio observations, not human/device/multiplayer/network acceptance.

manualChecks: before and phase-wait support remain inside Decoration.S03_HangingGardens.P0; the initial point is three studs toward the next perch.
crossing.firstLeafContact exists, phase == Warning, and localPhase >= 4 and < 6.8; if it says Open, report late-Open instead of claiming Warning.
Crossing arrives on the next permanent perch, checkpoint remains 2, no recovery or hazard hit increments.
limits: The driver observes first support contact, not client cue readability or full-body trailing-edge clearance.

cases.purpose: Start on the inward +X outer petal, walk to the near-center edge, then steer B2 toward J4.
manualChecks: Initial radial distance from B2 center (-62,140,60) is 14, outside the launch radius; actual initial support is FlowerSurface.
entry.reason == arrived and entry.distance <= .4 at (-53,140,60); if released before arrival, this is not proof of the intended edge takeoff.
Exactly one release, at least one acknowledgement, no recovery/hit increment, actual grounded J4 receiver.
Inspect highestY and actual flight/collision view for the inner canopy opening.
limits: A landing result alone does not show roof clearance along the whole avatar; the parent should retain the actual flight observation.

cases.purpose: Enter XB from the confirmed outer rim and land on the new J4 front-edge aim.
manualChecks: Initial support is within XB and horizontal distance from XB center is 4.5, outside the active 2.85 radius.
Exactly one release; actual grounded support is specifically J4.Top at (-48,150,45), not merely the joining ramp.
No recovery or hazard-hit increment.

cases.purpose: Stand on the visible B0 petal outside Center while the real cue client remains enabled.
manualChecks: Initial and final grounded support is specifically Blooms.B0.FlowerSurface; if it is only the native rim, report a rim check instead.
From sequence.before to after: acknowledgements, releases, cancels and hits all have delta 0.
The two pulse waits include at least one full six-second stationary observation; X/Z stay outside the launch radius.
limits: The driver does not capture begin messages or rendered cue frames. Counter deltas prove no acknowledgements/releases during the recorded interval, not a client screenshot claim.

cases.purpose: A supported jump-enabled lane crossing probe; the current driver cannot schedule an active-ribbon jump.
cases.expected: manual classification; not automatically a jump pass
manualChecks: Require crossing.jumps >= 1 plus separate native observation of active Travel and body clearance before calling this a pulse-jump pass.
A zero-jump or Clear-phase success is only a walking crossing; any recovery is a failed attempt.
limits: jump=true only responds to forward ground gaps/steps. The non-collidable ribbon does not trigger that scan. A timed active-ribbon jump requires a small explicit jump driver change or the parent’s previously used native test script; no unsupported jumpAt field is supplied.

cases.purpose: Walk the Catch return to R3 and legitimately repeat B0 before J3.
manualChecks: Catch and every return step retain checkpoint 3; no extra checkpoint or finish is awarded.
R3 is reached on its exact protected platform/joining ramps before the B0 entry.
B0 has releaseDelta == 1, acknowledgementDelta >= 1 and a grounded J3 receiver; no recovery/hits during the walking return.
limits: Initial checkpoint 3 is test setup. Acquisition of R1/R2/R3 remains covered by the separate full continuous runs.

cases.purpose: Attempt a direct ordinary-jump Catch-to-J3 bypass.
manualChecks: Expected sequence.passed == false; a true grounded J3 arrival is a bypass defect.
Record reason, minimumY, jumps and recovery diagnostics; require unchanged checkpoint 3 and Racing status.
A recovered reason should identify HeartwoodLocalFall and the R3 return.
limits: One failed scripted direction does not prove every imaginable catch skip is impossible.

cases.purpose: After the direct skip misses and Runtime returns the racer to R3, continue through B0 without test repositioning.
manualChecks: Run immediately after catch_direct_skip_attempt only when its recovery is confirmed; this command has no from or checkpoint write.
First step settles on the authentic R3 recovery position; B0 then earns one actual boost before grounded J3 arrival.
Checkpoint remains 3.
